name: configure-ruff-after-edit
description: Plan approval-gated Ruff checks after supported edits without activating a plugin hook.

interface.shortDescription: Plan approval-gated Ruff checks after edits.
interface.longDescription: Configure Ruff After Edit audits a declared project or user scope and proposes approval-gated Ruff after-edit behavior. Installing the plugin exposes only the skill; it does not activate a plugin hook or modify the target scope.
defaultPrompt: Use $configure-ruff-after-edit to audit this project and propose an approval-gated Ruff after-edit configuration.
